product_overview: Invictus AI Corporate Website serves as the premier digital storefront for Invictus AI, a service-based AI agency offering custom AI automation solutions, intelligent agents, and digital infrastructure for modern businesses. The site is designed to communicate the brand's enterprise-grade AI capabilities with startup speed, showcase seven distinct service offerings, and convert visitors into booked strategy calls through seamless user experience and integrations.
core_goals: Effectively convey Invictus AI's brand positioning and expertise in enterprise-grade AI solutions.
Showcase the full spectrum of seven specialized service offerings with detailed descriptions and expansions.
Drive visitor conversions by facilitating easy bookings for strategy calls through integrated booking platforms.
Establish credibility through client testimonials and real business case studies presented in an engaging carousel.
Rank well on search engines in India for relevant AI automation keywords to increase inbound traffic.
Offer an intuitive and responsive single-page application with smooth navigation and dynamic interactions across all devices.
Ensure high performance, accessibility, and SEO best practices to deliver a robust and user-friendly website experience.
key_features: Fixed sticky top navigation bar with dynamic transparency and mobile hamburger menu for seamless navigation.
Animated Hero section with headline, taglines, call-to-action buttons, and engaging floating visual elements.
Informative 'Who We Are' section with manifesto, animated terminal visual, and branded decorative elements.
Interactive Services grid displaying seven distinctive AI services with color-coded cards and expansion modal triggered by clicks or footer events.
Detailed Service Expansion Modal featuring challenge, solution, execution plan, and expected outcomes for each service, with smooth animations and accessibility.
Tabbed Use Cases section correlating to the services, with stats, bullet points, and animated transitions to illustrate practical benefits.
Process Timeline outlining a proven six-step framework from first call to full automation, complete with animated connectors and CTAs.
Client Stories carousel showcasing four key clients with auto-rotation, pause on hover, navigation controls, and real results.
Comprehensive Footer with brand information, clickable service links triggering expansions, contact details, and legal placeholders.
SEO and technical features including metadata, Open Graph, schema.org JSON-LD, sitemap, robots.txt, and analytics integrations (GTM and Search Console).
Responsive design adapting layouts for mobile, tablet, and desktop with optimized interactions and visual consistency.
Robust accessibility features with semantic HTML, keyboard navigation, focus indicators, ARIA labels, and color contrast compliance.
Performance optimizations targeting high Lighthouse scores, fast paint timings, optimized images, and no unused code in production.
user_flow_summary: User lands on the homepage greeted by a clear brand message and primary calls to action in the Hero section.
The fixed Navbar allows easy navigation across page sections: Who We Are, Services, Use Cases, How We Work, Client Stories, and Contact.
Visitors can scroll or use nav links to access detailed content; clicking on service cards or footer service links opens a modal with expanded service information.
Within the Services modal, users can read challenges, solutions, and outcomes and access booking CTAs leading to an external LeadConnector booking page opening in a new tab.
Users explore practical Use Cases by selecting tabs corresponding to services, with smooth animated content updates and highlighted active views.
Engagement continues with the Process Timeline demonstrating the project's workflow steps and linking again to book strategy calls.
Client Stories carousel auto-rotates to share success stories, with pause on hover and manual navigation controls for deeper exploration.
Footer provides quick access to service modals, contact info, and legal links, ensuring easy navigation and conversions across all devices.
validation_criteria: Navbar remains fixed and dynamically changes background upon scrolling; hamburger menu toggles correctly on mobile.
All internal navigation links scroll smoothly to the appropriate sections and external CTAs open booking page in new tabs.
Hero section’s animated floating cards and background blobs render and animate correctly on all viewports.
Who We Are section contains the terminal animation and displays stats badges with spring animations upon viewport entry.
All seven service cards appear with correct colors, titles, and icons; clicking them opens the service expansion modal with correct content.
Service Expansion modal opens and closes smoothly with backdrop and close button triggers, scrollable on smaller screens.
Use Cases tabs switch content with ‘currently viewing’ pulse indicators and animate transitions without jarring.
Process Timeline displays all six steps with icons and colors correctly; horizontal connector line animates on desktop.
Client Stories carousel auto-rotates every six seconds, pauses on hover, and navigation arrows and dots respond correctly.
Footer service links trigger scroll and open the corresponding service modal; contact info and legal links are functional.
SEO meta tags, OG tags, and JSON-LD structured data are present and valid; sitemap.xml and robots.txt accessible.
Page performs with Lighthouse performance scores ≥ 90, fast contentful paint times, and no layout shifts.
Accessibility standards met with keyboard navigation, ARIA labels for modals and carousel controls, focus styles, and sufficient color contrast.
Responsive layouts adjust correctly for mobile, tablet, and desktop with no horizontal overflow or clickable element issues.
All external links to booking and client websites open in new tabs without errors.
Google Tag Manager and Google Search Console integrations load and function as intended without console errors.
